// SYNTHETIC ONLY: no database, media services, customer data or external adapters.
import { FatalError, getStepMetadata, RetryableError, sleep } from "workflow";

async function syntheticStep(value: number) {
  "use step";
  return { value: value + 1, stepId: getStepMetadata().stepId };
}

async function retryOnce() {
  "use step";
  const { attempt } = getStepMetadata();
  if (attempt === 1) throw new RetryableError("synthetic transient failure", { retryAfter: 50 });
  return attempt;
}

async function fatalStep() {
  "use step";
  throw new FatalError("synthetic terminal failure");
}

export async function syntheticLifecycle(value: number) {
  "use workflow";
  const first = await syntheticStep(value);
  await sleep("100ms");
  const attempt = await retryOnce();
  const last = await syntheticStep(first.value);
  return { first, last, attempt };
}

export async function syntheticFailure() {
  "use workflow";
  await syntheticStep(0);
  await fatalStep();
}
